{{Top|leg}}
A '''lifter''' was a disc-shaped [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] that could only move vertically. They were employed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aris/Legends|Aris]]. An electrical current was passed through a [[Servo-pulsor/Legends|servo-pulsor]] to start the repulsorlift [[Engine/Legends|engine]].
